description:
Welcome to the first OpenRail Community Meetup! This event series takes place every second thursday of a month.

For this session, we invited two promising projects from Hack4Rail: DBringer and TaxiTetrix. Both tackle the problem of taxi voucher distribution in a different, yet complementary way.

We welcome everyone to join the meetup, no matter the involvement in OpenRail or area and level of expertise.

Welcome to the second OpenRail Community Meetup! This event series takes place every second thursday of a month.

In this session, we are talking about machine-readable railway regulations using the OSCAL standard. We will explore how railway regulations can become machine-readable and what this could mean for interoperability, automation, and digital innovation in the rail sector.

We welcome everyone to join the meetup, no matter the involvement in OpenRail or area and level of expertise.

summary: OpenRail Community Meetup: OSRD Roadmap Review
description:
Welcome to the OpenRail Community Meetup! This event series takes place every second thursday of a month.

In this session, we are talking about the roadmap of Open Source Railway Designer (OSRD) (https://osrd.fr/en). The mainteiners of OSRD will join us to talk about their short- and long-term plans and how the community can chime in as well.

We welcome everyone to join the meetup, no matter the involvement in OpenRail or area and level of expertise.

We would like to welcome you to visit us at InnoTrans, the International Trade Fair for Transport Technology.

OpenRail will be present with a booth. Our Board and Team members are looking forward to exchanging about Open Source in the railway sector, learning about your use-cases, and explaining how OpenRail can help you.

Please find more details on our participation and the schedule on our website.
